tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The screen ground: night indigo. Every screen paints its body with it.

tokens.name: sky-2
tokens.usage: Chrome that floats on the sky: the nav bar, bottom sheets, the Find field.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and tile surface (glance tiles, the Pocket sections, the guide chapters).

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface on a card: chips, inputs, secondary buttons, icon buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Interactive outline: secondary buttons, the Find button, inputs. At least 3:1 on card and sky.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on sky, sky-2, card and card-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, the second line of a row, inactive nav labels.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, caps micro-labels, timestamps. Still 4.5:1 on card and sky.

tokens.name: sunrise
tokens.usage: THE accent as text and strokes: the active nav item, the NOW marker, key numbers, links.

tokens.name: sunrise-fill
tokens.usage: Sunrise as a fill: the primary button, the sun disc on the arc, the you-are-here dot. Text on it is always on-sunrise.

tokens.name: on-sunrise
tokens.usage: The only text colour allowed on a sunrise-fill surface.

tokens.name: sunrise-soft
tokens.usage: A soft sunrise wash behind the NOW band or a selected row.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: what is planned and still ahead (future route legs, Planned chips, tomorrow).

tokens.name: lilac-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a Planned chip.

tokens.name: lilac-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Planned chip.

tokens.name: lilac-line
tokens.usage: Border of a Planned chip.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Booked: status dots, the Relay sweep's green, a booked leg's tick.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a Booked chip.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Booked chip.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border of a Booked chip.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pending / not booked: amber dashes on an unbooked leg, the Relay pause, the NOW note when the step is not booked.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a Not booked chip.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Not booked chip or an amber note.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of a Not booked chip.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Missing / deadline: a night with no bed, a hard visa deadline, the Capital-airport warning in Find.

tokens.name: crit-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a Missing chip.

tokens.name: crit-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Missing chip or a warning card.

tokens.name: crit-line
tokens.usage: Border of a Missing chip or a warning card.

tokens.name: opal-1
tokens.usage: Opal stop 1 (peach). Opal is an EDGE: only the one most important card per screen, and the sun arc. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: opal-2
tokens.usage: Opal stop 2 (rose). Also the pink end of today's route gradient.

tokens.name: opal-3
tokens.usage: Opal stop 3 (lilac).

tokens.name: opal-4
tokens.usage: Opal stop 4 (aqua). Closes the opal loop back to peach.

tokens.name: route-lit
tokens.usage: The road so far on the map: travelled legs, painted by Ink.

tokens.name: route-today
tokens.usage: The far end of today's leg gradient (route-lit → route-today → route-future). Today's leg is the only one that Flows.

tokens.name: route-future
tokens.usage: Legs still ahead: dotted lilac.

tokens.name: map-grid
tokens.usage: The faint dot grid and latitude lines behind the constellation map.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: A stop on the map. Stops are drawn only where the trip file stores real coordinates.

tokens.name: horizon-glow
tokens.usage: The low sunrise glow at the bottom of the screen, behind the nav and the mountains.

tokens.name: ridge-1
tokens.usage: Back mountain ridge (decorative, never behind text).

tokens.name: ridge-2
tokens.usage: Middle mountain ridge.

tokens.name: ridge-3
tokens.usage: Front mountain ridge.

tokens.name: ridge-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px sunlit stroke along the front ridge.

tokens.name: counter-paper
tokens.usage: White = for other eyes. The ground of Counter mode, the driver card and driver-card chips.

tokens.name: counter-paper-2
tokens.usage: A quiet band inside a for-other-eyes screen (the route line under the code).

tokens.name: counter-ink
tokens.usage: Text on counter-paper: the huge code, the Chinese destination.

tokens.name: counter-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on counter-paper (the English line under the Chinese, the route).

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: The street map's land (Map tab, map4-map): the ground under every street and label, and the night canvas when no map pack is on the phone.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Water on the street map: deep indigo, with a faint aqua edge.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Parks, gardens and woods on the street map: a green-black.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Words on the street map: districts, neighbourhoods, countries, the places OpenStreetMap names. Neutral on purpose — colour on the map means the trip's own categories.

tokens.name: map-label-dim
tokens.usage: The quietest words on the street map: minor street names, house numbers, regions. Still 4.5:1 on the land.

tokens.name: map-label-road
tokens.usage: Major road names on the street map.

tokens.name: map-label-city
tokens.usage: City and town names on the street map.

tokens.name: map-label-water
tokens.usage: The names of rivers, lakes and seas, on the water itself.

tokens.name: map-label-park
tokens.usage: Parks, peaks and viewpoints OpenStreetMap names on the street map.

tokens.name: map-label-transit
tokens.usage: Stations, airports and ferry terminals OpenStreetMap names on the street map.

tokens.name: cat-food
tokens.usage: The Food category (MAPS6): its pin's ring and icon, its chip, its caps line. A place type, never a booking status.

tokens.name: cat-spa
tokens.usage: The Spa category: pin, chip and caps line.

tokens.name: cat-sight
tokens.usage: The Sight category: pin, chip and caps line.

tokens.name: cat-show
tokens.usage: The Show category: pin, chip and caps line.

tokens.name: cat-shopping
tokens.usage: The Shopping category: pin, chip and caps line.

tokens.name: cat-hotel
tokens.usage: The Hotel category: pin, chip and caps line. Tonight's bed also wears a sunrise ring.

tokens.name: cat-transport
tokens.usage: The Transport category — stations, airports, piers: pin, chip and caps line.

tokens.name: cat-medical
tokens.usage: The Medical category: pin (on a white-ringed disc), chip and caps line.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The system name and the trips-shelf wordmark only.

styles.name: city-title
styles.usage: A city's name on its close-up and guide.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A card or chapter title. Never below 18px in Unbounded.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The sandstone pillars of Wulingyuan are what Avatar borrowed.
styles.usage: Prose: the guide, the Concierge sentence.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: The first line of a list row or tile.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Be at Daxing by ~16:45 — not Capital
styles.usage: Second lines and captions. The smallest size for a sentence.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels only (set text-transform: uppercase). Never a sentence at this size.

styles.name: counter-code
styles.usage: The booking code in Counter mode. Always set font-stretch: 87.5% and tabular-nums.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: The loudest number on a screen: the countdown to the next commitment.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Booking numbers and flight codes in running UI.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside a chip; hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; inside tight rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in the glance rail and the bento; list row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The screen gutter and card padding. Every screen keeps 16px sides.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of hero cards (the pass, the Focus card).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Before a chapter in the guide; around full-screen modes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the nav bar ends, the Find button.

tokens.name: radius-photo
tokens.usage: Photos, the top of a bottom sheet (top corners only), the nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the pass.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Glance tiles and Pocket sections.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: A panel inside a card (the code strip, the counter code box).

tokens.name: radius-button-sm
tokens.usage: Small square-ish buttons inside a pass.

tokens.name: radius-chip-sm
tokens.usage: Icon wells and small tags.

shadow.note: Horizon lifts with light edges and soft glows on the night sky.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and tile.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float over the map: the nav bar, the Find button, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: glow-sunrise
tokens.usage: Under the primary sunrise button.

tokens.name: glow-opal
tokens.usage: Around the ONE opal-edged card on a screen.

duration.note: Motion timings. The motion rules live in the README (Motion).

tokens.name: duration-flow
tokens.usage: Flow: one dash cycle on today's leg. Loops, linear. The only looping route motion.

tokens.name: duration-comet
tokens.usage: Comet: one flight along a leg, once, ease-out, flash on arrival.

tokens.name: duration-ink
tokens.usage: Ink: a finished leg paints itself once, then stays painted.

tokens.name: duration-relay-demo
tokens.usage: The Relay demo loop on the motion board. In the app Relay runs once when Journey opens.

tokens.name: duration-ping
tokens.usage: The you-are-here ripple (ambient, allowed besides route motion).

tokens.name: duration-sun
tokens.usage: The sun disc's glow breathing (ambient).

tokens.name: duration-opal
tokens.usage: The opal edge drift (ambient) on the one opal card.

tokens.name: duration-rise
tokens.usage: A sheet or card entering (translateY 24px → 0).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances, Comet, sheets.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Flow and Ink strokes (constant speed along the route).
